identity.title: Block Run until damaged Recipe persistence is explicitly recovered

origin.kind: scheduled 2D task execution and source review
origin.summary: 2D-019 requires damaged existing Recipe/Pipeline data to remain inspectable and recoverable without being treated as a normal runnable Recipe.

state.current_summary: The existing Recipe/Pipeline persistence states are now consumed by the Pipeline Review Run owner, while the existing Recipe command gates remain in place. Isolated Debug/Release contracts prove source-byte and backup preservation, explicit SaveRecovered release, and new-Recipe default creation.

objective.summary: Verify and close the execution gate for damaged Recipe data and Pipeline XML without removing the existing editable-substitute recovery flow.
constraints: Keep the missing-file new Recipe default creation path allowed.
Preserve original source bytes and invalid backups; never overwrite a damaged source as part of the gate check.
Require the existing explicit storage owner Save path to produce SaveRecovered before Run is allowed.
Reuse the existing persistence state and presenter owners; do not add a parallel recovery format or broad Runner state.
Keep test fixtures, logs, and reports under D:\OpenVisionLab-TestData\OpenVisionLab_Dev.
Do not modify C:\Git\2D\Original or perform commit, push, release, deployment, or external communication.

criteria.text: A missing new Recipe creates its default Pipeline without a failure state, while damaged existing Pipeline XML and Recipe data return editable substitutes with preserved source bytes and an existing invalid backup.

A valid file repaired outside the persistence owner remains blocked while the failure state is stale; the explicit existing Save owner changes it to SaveRecovered, retains the prior backup, and releases the option gate.

Pipeline Review Run checks both Pipeline and RecipeData persistence failures before starting execution and presents the shared recovery guidance; existing Recipe sample, pair, catalog, and local-validation command gates continue to consume HasSelectedRecipePersistenceFailure.
The focused persistence-execution contract passes in Debug and Release, and Recipe-load recovery, future-schema fail-closed, and layer/reference invariants remain passing.
Durable completion evidence records the owner, call path, mutable-state writer, public contract, shortest reading order, focused checks, and the remaining WPF runtime/UI boundary.

context.location: VisionPipelineStorage and RecipeDataStorage own persistence state and source/backup writes; OpenVisionRecipePersistenceStatusPresenter owns recovery text; OpenVisionPipelineReviewDocument owns direct Review Run admission; RecipeCommandSurface owns sample/pair/catalog/local-validation CanExecute gates.

Recipe/Pipeline Load -> PersistenceStateKind -> OpenVisionRecipePersistenceStatusPresenter -> OpenVisionPipelineReviewDocument.RunReviewAsync and RecipeCommandSurface CanRun* gates -> execution only after explicit SaveRecovered.
VisionPipelineStorage.Save and RecipeDataStorage.Save are the only recovery writers used by this slice; the Review document only reads state and updates validation/guide presentation.

Missing files may create defaults. Existing damaged/schema-blocked files remain source-preserving failure states; the shared help text identifies the source and backup and prohibits Run/validation/qualification evidence until explicit save and reopen.

In-process Debug/Release contracts and source checks were run. A desktop WPF/EXE click path, rendered recovery state, themes/layouts/DPI/input matrix, camera/hardware, release/publication, and Original repository were not exercised in this slice.

Focused regressions passed: Recipe load recovery 8/0, future-schema compatibility 7/0, and Pipeline layer/reference invariant contract passed.

The stable contract, current handoff, and focused smoke dispatch record the persistence recovery gate, owner/call path, verification commands, evidence locations, next 2D-020 boundary, and the unverified desktop WPF runtime boundary.
